python_policy: Target: accepted non-root Linux Python 3.12 venv in place; exact package identities checked; no installations
implementation_decisions: Five-round full-size cells from the previously specified pilot matrix, not main experiments or timing repeats.
All 10833 routine training sessions and all 3622 routine validation sessions. Original per-client five-round manifests are retained byte for byte; no draws regenerated from scores.
Reference visits every training session once per round. Non-IID uses the original with-replacement 60/40 department schedule. Weights count draw occurrences, not unique sampled sessions or events.
Client counts 3609/3548/3676 require 57/56/58 batches with final batch sizes 25/28/28. Last batches are retained; their losses are means over actual sessions, with unchanged masking.
Same original model, optimiser, dropout, gradient clipping, local epoch and per-client/round RNG mapping as the accepted patched smoke run. Fresh global state, fresh AdamW each fit.
Weighted global routine losses use actual per-client counts, not an unweighted mean across clients. No threshold, test score, AP, AUROC or threat-label analysis.
Reuse the accepted .venv_full_candidate without pip or installations. Original and accepted environment source inventories are checked before/after.
Unchanged loopback endpoints, command PATH, process lifecycle, port release, FAB resource carrier and PRG identity controls.
Stock Flower FedAvg plus independent float64 check in B. C reuses the approved PRG backport and stock SecAggPlusWorkflow; no individual update or output digest diagnostic channel in C.
Runtime timings/RSS/message payload sizes are engineering diagnostics, not a final network-byte or secure aggregation overhead result.
All 3 clients required throughout; no automatic retry, plain fallback, resumption or weakened acceptance to force success.
